g.text: Selection Mode: Changes behavior of 12C lines to "selection" lines which determines which RAM settings to load on power up. See pg. 15 of Datasheet.
Default Unshifted 7 bit Address: 0x6A Alternate Address: 0x6B
Cut to remove I2C Pullup Resistors
Coplanar Transmission Calculation: 14mil trace width w/ 5mil isolate on all clock output = 61 Ohm Impedance
Fill jumper to enable Selection Mode.
